adopt_confirm.title: Link panel

menu_options.access_codes: Codes for locks and alarm panels (all displays)

entities.title: Entity configuration
entities.description: Applies to all displays. Switchable entities: switch, input_boolean, automation, fan, humidifier, remote and siren. Automations are enabled/disabled. Scenes and scripts are started; buttons and input buttons are pressed once.

data_description.locks: Can only be operated from a paired (encrypted) display with a Web Admin password. Home Assistant checks the code, or the Bridge when one is set under “Codes for locks and alarm panels”.
data_description.alarm_panels: Can only be operated from a paired (encrypted) display with a Web Admin password. Home Assistant checks the code, or the Bridge when one is set under “Codes for locks and alarm panels”.
data_description.open_without_code: Warning: anyone at the display can unlock, open or disarm these locks and alarm panels without a code. Only for devices without their own code or with a default code.

access_codes.title: Codes for locks and alarm panels
access_codes.description: Optional. Many devices ignore a wrong code without reporting an error: Home Assistant then reports success, and the display can show neither “wrong code” nor the lockout after several wrong codes. With a code here, the Bridge checks every code from a display itself and passes only a correct one on to Home Assistant. Separate several codes with commas. Leave it empty when Home Assistant already reports a wrong code. When the code on the device changes, change it here too.
